data.name: Fawad
data.gender_notes: Fawad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fawad is an Arabic name meaning 'heart' — symbolizing the emotional and spiritual core of a person. It is associated with sincerity, depth of feeling, and a compassionate soul. The name Fawad carries the meaning “Heart, Core of Emotion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Fawad usually hope their child will grow to embody heart, core of emotion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents deep emotional connection, sincerity, and purity of heart — someone whose feelings guide their actions with kindness.
data.etymology: Fawad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heart, Core of Emotion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawad total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فَوَاد
in_arabic.meaning: رجل العناية بالخير والصالحة وعدم الإهمال
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفواد هو اسم علم عربي يرمز إلى الفعل الفاعل المنطوي على معنى العناية بالخير والصالحة، ويقوم على حرف الفاء، والواو، والدا، فهو يعني الرجل الذي يعتني بالخير والصالحة، ويعد من الأسماء ذات الصلة بالخير والبركة في الإسلام، ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأعراف، ويتضمن أيضًا معنى الحفظ والرعاية، وتسمية الأفراد لهذا الاسم تهدف إلى تنمية صفات الخير والبركة فيهم، والتعامل مع الأشياء بروح الحفظ والرعاية

in_urdu.name: فَواد
in_urdu.meaning: خير کرنے والے شخص کی طرف سے ہر چیز کا خیال رکھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فَواد ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عربی روایات سے تعلق رکھتا ہے، اس کے معنی ہیں خیر کرنے والے شخص کی طرف سے ہر چیز کا خیال رکھنے والا، یہ نام عرب روایات کے مطابق خیر اور برکت کا نام ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لیے بہت اہم ہے، اس کی اصل عرب روایات میں موجود ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لیے بہت اہم ہے

in_english.name: Fawad
in_english.meaning: A person who takes care of goodness and righteousness and does not neglect
in_english.long_meaning: Fawad is an Arabic name that means a person who takes care of goodness and righteousness and does not neglect, it is derived from the root F-W-D, which means to take care of and to protect, in the Quran, it is mentioned in Surah Al-A'raf, it is also associated with the meaning of preservation and care, giving this name to a person aims to develop virtues of goodness and righteousness in them, and to deal with things with a spirit of preservation and care, in Islamic tradition, Fawad is considered a name with spiritual significance and cultural importance

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, Fawad may be associated with the concept of "Qalb" from Islamic theology, which means "heart" or the center point of incredible powers and potentials. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) stated, "Verily, in the body there is a morsel of flesh which, if it is whole, all the body is whole, and if it is corrupt, all of it is corrupt. It is the heart." (Sahih Bukhari, Volume 5, Book 56, Number 795).
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Fawad has deep connections with Sufism, the mystical branch of Islam. In Sufi teachings, the heart is a symbol of love, devotion, and connection to Allah. The name Fawad can serve as a constant reminder for its bearer to nurture the spiritual qualities of authentic love, compassion, and sincerity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fawad: Radiant, shining bright, like a star in the night sky. In Islamic tradition, the name Fawad signifies one who is a beacon of light, leading the way through darkness.
